ja: これは冗談でしょう?

key: ADRIENN: No... Too elaborate to be a joke.
en: ADRIENN: No... Too elaborate to be a joke.
ja: アドリエンヌ: いいえ……冗談にしては手が込みすぎているわ。

key: I must be dreaming.
en: I must be dreaming.
ja: きっと夢を見ているんだわ。

key: RADOMUS: Were this but a dream, it would be all the easier.
en: RADOMUS: Were this but a dream, it would be all the easier.
ja: ラドマス: これが夢であったなら、どれほど楽なことか。

key: Alas, it is not.
en: Alas, it is not.
ja: だが、残念ながら違う。

key: ADRIENN: I feel sick.
en: ADRIENN: I feel sick.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 気分が悪いわ。

key: RADOMUS: Steel your nerves for a moment and answer me this:
en: RADOMUS: Steel your nerves for a moment and answer me this:
ja: ラドマス: 少し気持ちを強く持って、これに答えてくれ。

key: This building has been this way for a long time, yet you are in shock.
en: This building has been this way for a long time, yet you are in shock.
ja: この建物はずっと前からこの有様だというのに、君は動揺している。

key: How is this?
en: How is this?
ja: これはどういうことか?

key: ADRIENN: When I left this morning, it was perfectly fine.
en: ADRIENN: When I left this morning, it was perfectly fine.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 今朝ここを出たときは、何の問題もなかったのに。

key: None of this--
en: None of this--
ja: こんなの……

key: This whole city--
en: This whole city--
ja: この街全部が……

key: It's wrong.
en: It's wrong.
ja: おかしいわ。

key: RADOMUS: As I thought.
en: RADOMUS: As I thought.
ja: ラドマス: やはりそうか。

key: Then allow me to tell you what I know about this Gym.
en: Then allow me to tell you what I know about this Gym.
ja: では、このジムについて私が知っていることを話そう。

key: When the city was repopulated after the blackouts and earthquakes, several buildings were designated to remain untouched.
en: When the city was repopulated after the blackouts and earthquakes, several buildings were designated to remain untouched.
ja: 大停電と地震の後、街に人が戻ってきたとき、いくつかの建物は手をつけないまま残すよう定められた。

key: In general, these were historically-significant facilities that their legacy might be preserved.
en: In general, these were historically-significant facilities that their legacy might be preserved.
ja: その多くは歴史的に重要な施設で、その記憶を後世に残すためだった。

key: This Gym was one such building.
en: This Gym was one such building.
ja: このジムもその一つだ。

key: ADRIENN: Blackouts? Earthquakes?
en: ADRIENN: Blackouts? Earthquakes?
ja: アドリエンヌ: 大停電? 地震?

key: RADOMUS: This is all unheard of to you, yes?
en: RADOMUS: This is all unheard of to you, yes?
ja: ラドマス: 君にとっては初耳、ということだな?

key: ADRIENN: I'm really confused.
en: ADRIENN: I'm really confused.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 本当に混乱しているの。

key: RADOMUS: Understandably.
en: RADOMUS: Understandably.
ja: ラドマス: 無理もない。

key: Then allow me to clarify another thing:
en: Then allow me to clarify another thing:
ja: では、もう一つはっきりさせておこう。

key: A moment ago, you said "this morning" that this Gym was normal to you.
en: A moment ago, you said "this morning" that this Gym was normal to you.
ja: 先ほど君は、「今朝」までこのジムは普通だったと言った。

key: Earlier, you said you arrived at the ruin around "an hour" before us.
en: Earlier, you said you arrived at the ruin around "an hour" before us.
ja: また、あの遺跡に着いたのは私たちより「一時間」ほど前だったとも言っていたな。

key: Do I recall correctly?
en: Do I recall correctly?
ja: 私の記憶に間違いはないか?

key: ADRIENN: Yes, but I'm... afraid I hardly follow.
en: ADRIENN: Yes, but I'm... afraid I hardly follow.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ええ、でも……正直、話についていけないわ。

key: RADOMUS: To put it simply, based on your description of this city and your memory of what's happened,
en: RADOMUS: To put it simply, based on your description of this city and your memory of what's happened,
ja: ラドマス: 簡単に言えば、君のこの街についての話と、君の記憶をもとに考えると、

key: I believe there is only one conclusion that can be reached:
en: I believe there is only one conclusion that can be reached:
ja: 導き出せる結論は一つしかないと私は思う。

key: You've been frozen in time.
en: You've been frozen in time.
ja: 君は、時間の中に閉じ込められていたのだ。

key: ADRIENN: I've-- what...?
en: ADRIENN: I've-- what...?
ja: アドリエンヌ: わたしが……何ですって?

key: RADOMUS: When you fell down into the ruin, as you said, how did you get there?
en: RADOMUS: When you fell down into the ruin, as you said, how did you get there?
ja: ラドマス: 君はさっき、あの遺跡に落ちたと言ったが、どうやってそこに?

key: ADRIENN: I was checking something out in the mechanical hall behind the Grand Gates.
en: ADRIENN: I was checking something out in the mechanical hall behind the Grand Gates.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 大門の裏にある機械室で、何かを調べていたの。

key: Someone reported they had seen some kind of light shining through the floor, so I dismantled part of it and crawled down there.
en: Someone reported they had seen some kind of light shining through the floor, so I dismantled part of it and crawled down there.
ja: 床の隙間から光のようなものが見えると報告があって、床の一部を外して下に潜り込んだのよ。

key: But when I lost my footing, I fell underground.
en: But when I lost my footing, I fell underground.
ja: でも足を滑らせて、地下に落ちてしまって。

key: Following a natural tunnel, I eventually came to that place.
en: Following a natural tunnel, I eventually came to that place.
ja: 自然にできたトンネルをたどっていったら、いつの間にかあの場所に着いていたの。

key: RADOMUS: When you say you were in the Grand Gates, does that mean you accessed them as normal from the Grand Stairway?
en: RADOMUS: When you say you were in the Grand Gates, does that mean you accessed them as normal from the Grand Stairway?
ja: ラドマス: 大門にいたということは、いつも通り大階段から入ったということか?

key: ADRIENN: Yes. Why?
en: ADRIENN: Yes. Why?
ja: アドリエンヌ: ええ。それが何か?

key: RADOMUS: Then that confirms it.
en: RADOMUS: Then that confirms it.
ja: ラドマス: それで確信が持てた。

key: The Gates have been inoperable for years.
en: The Gates have been inoperable for years.
ja: 大門はもう何年も機能していない。

key: More than a decade ago, they suddenly ceased function.
en: More than a decade ago, they suddenly ceased function.
ja: 十年以上前、突然動かなくなったのだ。

key: ADRIENN: I don't remember anything like that.
en: ADRIENN: I don't remember anything like that.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そんなこと、まったく覚えがないわ。

key: RADOMUS: Of course not. You were inside the ruin that entire time.
en: RADOMUS: Of course not. You were inside the ruin that entire time.
ja: ラドマス: 当然だろう。君はその間ずっと、あの遺跡の中にいたのだから。

key: If we are to believe what El told us about that being the site of Arceus' birth, there is no telling what kind of energy afflicts that place.
en: If we are to believe what El told us about that being the site of Arceus' birth, there is no telling what kind of energy afflicts that place.
ja: エルが言っていた、あそこがアルセウス誕生の地だという話を信じるなら、あの場所にどんなエネルギーが働いていてもおかしくない。

key: It is possible the energy of the meteor concealed inside the ruin warped the flow of time, and the Gates' function with it.
en: It is possible the energy of the meteor concealed inside the ruin warped the flow of time, and the Gates' function with it.
ja: 遺跡の中に隠されたいん石のエネルギーが時の流れをゆがめ、それとともに大門の機能も狂わせたのかもしれない。

key: ADRIENN: Then shouldn't you all have been stuck with me too?
en: ADRIENN: Then shouldn't you all have been stuck with me too?
ja: アドリエンヌ: だったら、あなたたちも一緒に閉じ込められていたはずじゃない?

key: RADOMUS: A valid concern; however, we had something you did not.
en: RADOMUS: A valid concern; however, we had something you did not.
ja: ラドマス: もっともな疑問だ。だが我々には、君が持っていなかったものがあった。

key: CAIN: The keys! The Ruby Ring and Amethyst Pendant!
en: CAIN: The keys! The Ruby Ring and Amethyst Pendant!
ja: カイン: 鍵だよ! ルビーのゆびわとアメジストのペンダント!

key: RADOMUS: Perhaps their presence, and the energy they bear connected to the ruin, was enough to unlock you from the spell of frozen time.
en: RADOMUS: Perhaps their presence, and the energy they bear connected to the ruin, was enough to unlock you from the spell of frozen time.
ja: ラドマス: おそらく、それらが持つ遺跡と結びついたエネルギーが、君にかけられた時間停止の呪縛を解くのに十分だったのだろう。

key: ADRIENN: So I was underground for-- who knows how long-- and I had no idea...
en: ADRIENN: So I was underground for-- who knows how long-- and I had no idea...
ja: アドリエンヌ: つまりわたしは、どれだけの間か分からないくらい長く地下にいて、それに気づきもしなかった……

key: To me it just seemed like an hour...
en: To me it just seemed like an hour...
ja: わたしにはたった一時間くらいにしか感じられなかったのに……

key: That's... a bad feeling.
en: That's... a bad feeling.
ja: それは……嫌な気分ね。

key: CAIN: What are you going to do now?
en: CAIN: What are you going to do now?
ja: カイン: これからどうするんだよねぇ?

key: ADRIENN: Well... I can't just leave this place like this.
en: ADRIENN: Well... I can't just leave this place like this.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そうね……こんな状態のまま、放っておけないわ。

key: GARDEVOIR: You're gonna try and fix your Gym?
en: GARDEVOIR: You're gonna try and fix your Gym?
ja: サーナイト: このジムを直そうとしているんですか?

key: You've got your work cut out for you!
en: You've got your work cut out for you!
ja: それは骨が折れそうですね!

key: ADRIENN: No.
en: ADRIENN: No.
ja: アドリエンヌ: いいえ。

key: Not the Gym.
en: Not the Gym.
ja: ジムじゃないわ。

key: I mean the whole city.
en: I mean the whole city.
ja: この街全部よ。

key: RADOMUS: You intend to fix the whole city?
en: RADOMUS: You intend to fix the whole city?
ja: ラドマス: 街全体を直すつもりか?

key: ADRIENN: I intend to do what I can.
en: ADRIENN: I intend to do what I can.
ja: アドリエンヌ: わたしにできることをするだけよ。

key: This is wrong.
en: This is wrong.
ja: こんなの間違っているわ。

key: This is not Reborn.
en: This is not Reborn.
ja: これはリボーンじゃない。

key: But if someone like me can do something--
en: But if someone like me can do something--
ja: でも、わたしみたいな者でも何かできるなら――

key: Anything to bring it just a little bit closer to the way it should be...
en: Anything to bring it just a little bit closer to the way it should be...
ja: ほんの少しでも、あるべき姿に近づけられることなら何でも……

key: Then that's worth doing.
en: Then that's worth doing.
ja: それだけの価値はあるわ。

key: Is there someone in charge that I can speak to?
en: Is there someone in charge that I can speak to?
ja: 誰か話ができる責任者はいるの?

key: CAIN: Wellllll, Ame is usually around the Grand Hall at the city center.
en: CAIN: Wellllll, Ame is usually around the Grand Hall at the city center.
ja: カイン: えーっとぉ、アメなら大体、街の中心にある大ホールにいるよねぇ。

key: ADRIENN: I can't imagine that's moved far.
en: ADRIENN: I can't imagine that's moved far.
ja: アドリエンヌ: それはあまり変わってなさそうね。

key: You have my thanks.
en: You have my thanks.
ja: 感謝するわ。

key: ...For getting me out of there, too, if that is indeed what happened.
en: ...For getting me out of there, too, if that is indeed what happened.
ja: ……それに、本当にそうだったなら、わたしをあそこから助け出してくれたことも。

key: GARDEVOIR: Good luck fixing the whole city~
en: GARDEVOIR: Good luck fixing the whole city~
ja: サーナイト: 街全体を直すの、頑張ってくださいね～

key: Maybe you'll want to stop time again to do that!
en: Maybe you'll want to stop time again to do that!
ja: それだけの作業をするなら、また時間を止めたくなるかもしれませんね!

key: ADRIENN: Hah, maybe so.
en: ADRIENN: Hah, maybe so.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ふふ、そうかもしれないわね。

key: Wouldn't that be nice?
en: Wouldn't that be nice?
ja: そうできたら素敵でしょうね。

key: I'll see you all around, perhaps in a slightly brighter future.
en: I'll see you all around, perhaps in a slightly brighter future.
ja: また会いましょう、少し明るい未来で、きっと。

key: RADOMUS: Well, that turned out to be an ordeal.
en: RADOMUS: Well, that turned out to be an ordeal.
ja: ラドマス: いや、なかなかの試練だったな。

key: GARDEVOIR: Yup! And this'll make a niiiice juicy news story, too~
en: GARDEVOIR: Yup! And this'll make a niiiice juicy news story, too~
ja: サーナイト: ですね! これはとびきりのニュースネタになりそうです～

key: RADOMUS: Before that, Gardevoir, I'll be needing you.
en: RADOMUS: Before that, Gardevoir, I'll be needing you.
ja: ラドマス: その前に、サーナイト、頼みがある。

key: These two still have Gym Battles to do, after all.
en: These two still have Gym Battles to do, after all.
ja: この二人には、まだジム戦をこなしてもらわなくてはならないからな。

key: GARDEVOIR: Ooooh. Well, if that's how it is~
en: GARDEVOIR: Ooooh. Well, if that's how it is~
ja: サーナイト: おおっと。まあ、そういうことでしたら～

key: We'll be waiting back at the Castle!
en: We'll be waiting back at the Castle!
ja: お城でお待ちしていますね!

key: RADOMUS: Indeed. I will see you shortly.
en: RADOMUS: Indeed. I will see you shortly.
ja: ラドマス: うむ。すぐに向かおう。

key: CAIN: Hey, \PN. Do you want to walk with us back to the castle right away?
en: CAIN: Hey, \PN. Do you want to walk with us back to the castle right away?
ja: カイン: なあ、\PN。今すぐ一緒に城まで歩いて帰る?

key: CAIN: All righty, let's all go together~
en: CAIN: All righty, let's all go together~
ja: カイン: よっしゃ、みんなで一緒に行こうよねぇ～

key: CAIN: That's fine. See you later, \PN!
en: CAIN: That's fine. See you later, \PN!
ja: カイン: オーケー。じゃあまたね、\PN!

key: RADOMUS: Whenever you're ready.
en: RADOMUS: Whenever you're ready.
ja: ラドマス: 準備ができたらでいい。

key: GARDEVOIR: Now accepting bets on if xe goes off the deep end!
en: GARDEVOIR: Now accepting bets on if xe goes off the deep end!
ja: サーナイト: あの人が限界を迎えるかどうか、賭けを受け付けますよ!

key: RADOMUS: Hm. This is going to be difficult.
en: RADOMUS: Hm. This is going to be difficult.
ja: ラドマス: ふむ。これは一筋縄ではいかなそうだ。

key: CAIN: So this old place belonged to Adrienn, huh?
en: CAIN: So this old place belonged to Adrienn, huh?
ja: カイン: てことは、この古い場所、アドリエンヌのものだったんだよねぇ?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
